content: Real estate developer project pages (2026 sources: Traficore, VASUYASHII, EffectLab, webcodeskills, dignuzdesign, videinfra) converge on a narrative section order: hero (name+location+positioning+single primary CTA) -> overview/about -> location logic + nearby landmarks with commute times -> unit configurations & floor plans -> amenities -> trust/progress -> gallery -> map -> FAQ -> persistent CTA/enquiry. Common section sets: hero, project overview, unit configs (area basis), floor plans, amenities, gallery, location/map, progress/construction status, pricing context, possession timeline, approvals/registration, testimonials, FAQ, enquiry form, WhatsApp CTA. Sequence matters more than inventory: frame project value before specs; CTA after hero, mid-narrative, and after proof.
